close_reason: Pattern no longer exists in calendars-client. Verified 2026-05-09: rg 'for id in id_slice' in crate-jmap-calendars-client/src/methods returned no matches. Remaining .iter() calls are inside expression chains like props.iter().copied().map(...) where .iter() is required (not the for-loop anti-pattern this bead targeted). Either fixed in an unrelated commit or the line references in the description were stale at filing.
description:
Pattern at calendar.rs:24, event.rs:26, event_notification.rs:21, participant_identity.rs:15, calendar.rs:82, event.rs:91, event_notification.rs:85, participant_identity.rs:69:

```
for id in id_slice.iter() {
```

`for x in &slice` is the idiomatic form; `.iter()` is redundant. Clippy lints this as `needless_iter`. The crate ships `-D warnings` clean today only because that lint is in clippy::pedantic / nursery, not the default group.

Eight occurrences in production code. Trivial to fix; appears in newly-added code so a contributor will copy the bad pattern into the next method added.
title: for id in id_slice.iter() — drop the .iter()
